4. Near real-time indexing for quick results of recently added entries.
3. Highly available system (no single point of failure).
4. Eventual consistency between index and source data.
CDC to update the Inverted Indexes
Tokeniser Service converts all the texts/strings into tokens (i.e. breaking entire sentence/paragraph into words)
Indexing Service maintains inverted index that is a key value pair where keys will be all the tokens and values will be array of
ids of rows in which this token can be found.
Ranker Service sorts the IDs based on the token occurrences (i.e. an ID with maximum tokens matching will be on top).
